question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Vital
solution:
The correct answer is "Trivial". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **
 

__
 
• Let us understand the **meaning** of the **given** and the **marked words:**

 
 
• Vital means something very important or necessary (बहुत महत्वपूर्ण).

 
 
• Synonyms: Essential, indispensable, or crucial.

 
 
• Example: *Consistency is** vital **to success.*
 
 
 
 
 
• Trivial means something of little importance and not worth considering (महत्वहीन, मामूली).
 
 
• Synonyms: Unimportant or insignificant.
 
 
• Example: *She could remember every **trivial **incident in great detail.*
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• From the above explanation, it is clear that the word "trivial" is the antonym of "vital".
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2) Trivial.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

 
• Let us understand the **meaning **of the other given **words**.

 
 
• Critical means saying what is wrong with something or something very important or a deciding factor. (आलोचनात्‍मक)
 
• Manual** means a book that explains how to do or operate something or doing or operating something by hands. (जिसमें हाथों का प्रयोग हो; हस्‍त-चालित)
 
• Crucial means something extremely important because many other things depend on it. (अत्‍यधिक महत्वपूर्ण)
